label: OTP input
desc: A one-time-code field with N visual boxes over one real input (SMS autofill friendly): auto-advance, backspace, arrows, paste, pop on fill, shake on error and a check seal on success.
use: sign-in two-step verification, email confirmation, connect page pairing codes

label: Payment card
desc: A card-payment form whose card face updates live, flips to the back on CVC focus, formats and Luhn-checks the number, and plays a fake processing then success sequence (no network).
use: checkout, billing settings, upgrade plan dialog on a dashboard or landing page
